issues.description:
** The recorded full-suite runs are stale after the fix-delta guidance/config change.
  - **Category:** Completeness
  - **Severity:** Major
  - **Evidence paths:** `docs/session-sets/130-orchestrator-seat-cost-capture/test-runs.jsonl:1-3`, `docs/session-sets/130-orchestrator-seat-cost-capture/decisions.jsonl:4`, `ai_router/router-config.yaml:1352-1374`, `ai_router/run_of_record.py:16-21`, `ai_router/run_of_record.py:323-540`, `ai_router/run_of_record.py:1193-1300`
  - **Failure scenario:** The session proceeds to close using the three recorded `passed` runs, but those runs all predate the 04:01 fix-delta change to `ai_router/router-config.yaml`. That file is under `ai_router/`, which all three declared expensive suites cover, so this is probable on the main path: the run-of-record gate will either fail as stale or the session will be relying on validation that no longer covers the current tree.
  - **Acceptance criterion:** `python ai_router/run_of_record.py check --session-set-dir docs/session-sets/130-orchestrator-seat-cost-capture --files-changed ai_router/router-config.yaml docs/planning/project-guidance.md --check`
  - **Acceptance expectation:** exit 0
  - **Details:** Violation: the run-of-record policy says expensive suites run “after the last code change,” and the run gate fails when a run “PREDATES a change to the surfaces it covers”; the session’s own decision states the router-config edit means “all three runs of record stale and must be re-run.” Impact: a reasonable reviewer should not accept the verification evidence until the three affected suites are rerun and re-recorded after the config/guidance fix. Evidence: the latest test-run records are at 03:16, 03:17, and 03:57, while the guidance/config decision is at 04:01 and the current `router-config.yaml` contains that change.
